findings.evidence: A protected authoring route could remain above the root login gate after authentication was lost.
findings.resolution: AppAuthGate now removes all pushed routes on idle, unauthenticated, or error transitions; a widget regression test proves the protected route is removed.

findings.evidence: Two LoginRequested events could start duplicate repository calls before the loading UI rebuilt.
findings.resolution: AuthBloc now ignores login events while authentication is in flight; its unit test verifies one repository call.
